description: Public Handicap Parking Spaces is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. View full metadata Description This layer contains point features of curbside, designated handicapped parking spaces located in commercial areas. About Edit Dates This data is automatically updated on a set schedule. The Socrata edit date may not reflect the actual edit dates in the data. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are disabled, parking, accessible, vision zero. The table has 19 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Cambridge, MA GIS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
